why: arXiv:1504.04852 (M. Cocos, 'A Proof of Chern's Conjecture for Flat Affine Manifolds') has been repeatedly revised through at least v11/v12 with a version dated September 2025 and a related talk at the AMS Fall 2025 meeting, but it is unclear whether this claimed proof is accepted, still disputed, or superseded; Wikipedia (per search results) still describes the general conjecture as unsolved, and an earlier 2016 claimed proof by Feng and Zhang was retracted after a flaw was found (that retraction is pre-snapshot).
